Templates

Blank business documents to copy and fill in.

  • Business associate agreement request The short questionnaire that tells us whether a project involves health information, and if so, what the business associate agreement needs to cover. TemplatePDF
  • Business associate agreement An example HIPAA business associate agreement with neon1 LLC as the business associate, modeled on the HHS sample provisions. TemplatePDF
  • Decision review A two-page written review of one technology decision: the situation, the options with their costs, a recommendation, and the next step. TemplatePDF
  • Partner responsibilities Who does what when neon1 works alongside another firm: selling, building, support, billing, data, insurance, and exit. TemplatePDF
  • Proposal The one-document proposal neon1 sends after discovery: your problem, the result, what's in and out, schedule, price, and acceptance. TemplatePDF

Forms

Blank records used during an engagement.

  • Change request How a change to agreed scope is written down, priced, and approved before any work happens. FormPDF
  • Discovery and outcome record Everything learned about one real task before a solution is proposed: steps, baseline, desired result, and options. FormPDF
  • Incident and restore record A timestamped record of an interruption or restore test, what was affected, what was done, and what changes next. FormPDF
  • Intake The first record of a possible project: the problem, who's involved, and whether it's a fit. FormPDF
  • Metric record The exact definition of one measure: what counts, the formula, the source, the baseline, and the target. FormPDF
  • Publication permission record Your separate, specific permission before anything about your project appears in public. FormPDF
  • Release and handover record The checklist that closes a project: acceptance, ownership, recovery, training, access removal, and follow-up. FormPDF
  • Service and recovery profile What a running service must do, how it's measured, who supports it, and how it comes back after a failure. FormPDF
  • Tool and architecture decision A short record of a technology choice: the problem, the options, the evidence, the cost, and the way out. FormPDF
